# Captured event executions at recursive observations

Updated: 2026-10-19 12:25 CEST. Start: `60403eced`.
Source main: `b45051e3e`. Merge: `fec741514`. Proof: `d153d37d7`.

## System guarantee

Fresh construction always finishes in the Lean model. Under the stated
guard conditions, the result represents exactly the specified finite trees.
A completed supported root reduction with empty inherited constraints
preserves that exact language. General reduction completion and Haskell
refinement remain open. Read `notes-current-system-claim.md`.

## Captured event execution

`SourceCurrentClassEventExecutions.Source` retains a supported event heap.
The same complete event value is available there. An actual physical
interval connects that heap to the supplied later reader heap.

Its native case retains the actual target Force and query receipts. It
retains an actual checked request trace and a returned native cell with
its captured writer receipt. The query operands are closed. Native history
is retained at the captured before, query-entry and query-return states.
The cell and writer belong to that exact query return. `Source.later`
extends physical retention. It supplies no later native memo history.

The Head case retains the actual Head, its reads and the subsequent body
edit reads. It retains captured shared readiness, original availability,
closedness and native history. The event heap is the actual Head return.

`node` and `children` derive this source from the existing indexed Event
and ChildEvent relations. They need actual edit reads and initial support.
Their induction derives intermediate support through actual effects.
Private worker determinism laws align independently indexed graph returns.
Proof identity alone does not align hidden intermediate values or heaps.
No new duplicate event relation is introduced.

`occurrence` derives availability of a literal ordinary-child occurrence
from the event's availability and heap semantics. It follows no stored Mu
body, union member or observational unfolding row.

`SourceCurrentClassFoldEventExecutions.fold` extends extraction through
actual list edits, classes and the chronological right fold. Initial class
coherence, active paths, domains, readiness, inventory, availability, Merge
support, gate memo validity and native history remain explicit. Actual
completed tails derive each phase's input forest and support. Later actual
calls extend the earlier event's physical interval to the final fold heap.
The caller supplies no intermediate child or phase support.

## Supported remaining observation

`SourceCurrentRecursiveEntryObservation.Observation` retains the actual
remaining Project of the exact first recursive value. It retains the
actual complete row Read and the same selected full row. The receipt
includes semantic support, costs, availability, causal guard heaps and
forward retention from projection return to reader.

`entry` derives this receipt from an actual first recursive Entry. It also
derives physical retention from the outer projection entry to the internal
projection entry, and from the internal reader to the outer reader.
The original path equals the natural ordinary prefix followed by the
remaining signed path. Actual ordinary projection and read prefixes derive
the internal support. Actual suffixes derive the forward intervals.
Causal guard heaps restrict backward through these intervals. Heap growth
alone supplies no forward causal guard-heap law.

The internal selected index is existential. It can differ from the outer
selected index. Both reads select the exact same complete row.

## Read origins

`SourceCurrentRecursiveObservationReadOrigins.project_read` consumes the
actual recursive Project, its selected Read and indexed Spine. It needs
initial semantics, costs, availability, later reader semantics and forward
retention. Whole-value closedness and causal guard heaps are not premises.
It can consume the corresponding fields of the new Observation receipt.

An empty remaining path gives an epsilon Origin for the exact selected row
from the recursive value. A nonempty path retains the actual first Head,
its full raw and canonical source row indices, the selected child and
its continuation frame. The Head row has its Origin at the actual Head
return. That row can differ from the final selected deep row. The theorem
does not assert a deep-row epsilon Origin from the recursive value.

## Composed endpoint

`SourceCurrentRecursiveEventObservation.fold` takes actual Required
preparation, an original false gate, actual FoldReads and the actual
selected Project/Read. It derives the earlier source exclusion and fold
support. A nonplain row has an ordinary Route in the FINAL fold value,
or an actual earlier native/Head event contains its exact first recursive
value at a literal ordinary-child occurrence.

The recursive alternative now also retains that event's captured execution
and a supported remaining observation of the same recursive value and
full row. Actual physical intervals connect the captured event heap to
the recursive projection entry. The selected reader retains its separate
interval to the outer reader. No desired source execution is a premise.

Preparation and fold share the same returned forest. Their supported heaps
remain separate. This composes completed graphs. It does not derive the
complete chronological execution of one outer call. The ordinary Route
alternative does not assert an initial source row. The recursive branch
does not project the unchanged whole event through later class edits.

## Constructed checks

One actual ordinary projection has two source rows. The selected outer
row has index 1. The selected Mu operand read has index 0. Its exact Entry
derives the supported Observation and both surrounding intervals. The
derived receipt keeps its internal index existential.

A separate source-built used-Mu check forces the actual node and fold
event alternatives. Every initial ordinary-child source of that exact Mu
is excluded. The same FoldEvent derives its supported captured execution.
Its literal occurrence derives Mu availability at the event heap and then
at the final fold heap. Its original primary gate is true. It claims no
false-primary outer-driver execution, finite productivity, language
failure or Haskell defect.

In simple technical English: fresh construction always finishes in the
Lean model. Under the stated guard conditions, its result represents

modeled root reduction with empty inherited constraints preserves that
exact language.

FreshOrdinary build from the empty source heap. An actual original-field
allocation history must cover all expression guards. Its starting equality
interner must be valid. The modeled caller and its global memo tables
start logically empty. The inherited value is the actual empty allocation.

If the bounded root call returns, and Fits, carrier and scheduled Room
hold, its returned value is available and, for every ambient interpretation,

`L(result) = evaluate(original expression)`.

The statement covers the full source syntax, including nested raw and
smart binders and retained earlier cache writers. It supplies no semantic
Context, guard heap, Frame, root availability or desired result law.
